Step: Cox Proportional Hazards Model

step_cox.Rd

Perform survival analysis by fitting a Cox proportional hazards model using glystats::gly_cox() for each variable. This step identifies variables associated with survival outcomes. The upstream step supplies the experiment.

Usage

step_cox(time_col = "time", event_col = "event", p_adj_method = "BH", ...)

Arguments

time_col

Column name in sample information containing survival time. Default is "time".

event_col

Column name in sample information containing event indicator (1 for event, 0 for censoring). Default is "event".

p_adj_method

Method for adjusting p-values. See p.adjust.methods. Default is "BH". If NULL, no adjustment is performed.

...

Additional arguments passed to glystats::gly_cox().

Value

A glysmith_step object.

See also

glystats::gly_cox(), survival::coxph()

Examples

step_cox()
#> <step "step_cox()"> Cox proportional hazards model
step_cox(time_col = "survival_time", event_col = "death")
#> <step "step_cox(time_col = \"survival_time\", event_col = \"death\")"> Cox
#> proportional hazards model
